generations.prompt: Photoreal, a bright clear weekday afternoon on a wide tree-lined city boulevard a few years in the future, 35 mm, the camera locked off on the pavement at chest height looking down its length toward the pale blue sky; it does not move. People of all ages sit on the benches in the dappled shade reading and talking and eating ice cream, a couple walks a dog slowly away from the camera, two people drift past on bicycles, a child skips along beside an older man, and a slow quiet rounded pale tram glides along the grassed track in the middle distance; leaves stir in a light breeze; nobody hurries. Warm sun from the upper left. Sound: birdsong, leaves, distant easy conversation, the soft hum and gentle bell of the tram, a dog's single bark far away; no music. No cars. About ten people, none close to the camera. No on-screen text, no signs, no lettering, no banners anywhere.
